parsed.name: 传感器轮询线程
parsed.description: 用于实验自动化系统中的非物理软件线程组件，负责在后台周期性轮询传感器读数，并管理读数缓冲区与线程生命周期。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software thread component used in laboratory automation to poll sensor readings in the background and manage the reading buffer and thread lifecycle.

actions.description: 执行一次传感器读取或轮询操作。
actions.description_en: Perform one sensor read or polling operation.

actions.description: 读取当前缓冲区中已采集的传感器数据。
actions.description_en: Read the sensor data currently stored in the acquisition buffer.

actions.description: 重置或清空传感器数据缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Reset or clear the sensor data buffer.

actions.description: 终止后台传感器轮询线程。
actions.description_en: Terminate the background sensor polling thread.

actions.description: 检查轮询线程是否仍在运行。
actions.description_en: Check whether the polling thread is still running.

actions.description: 运行线程主循环以持续轮询传感器。
actions.description_en: Run the thread main loop to continuously poll the sensor.
